Displays the unique code number of the power unit.

descriere_scurta: Pressure sensor B reference value at 10 V
descriere: Sets the reference value for pressure sensor B to 10 V.

descriere_scurta: Operating hours counter power unit fan
descriere: Displays the power unit fan operating hours. The number of hours operated can only be reset to 0 in this parameter (e.g. after a fan has been replaced).

descriere_scurta: Cooling unit feedback signals signal source
descriere: Sets the signal sources for the feedback signals from the cooling unit. Index: [0] = Cooling unit powered up [1] = Cooling unit ready to be powered up [2] = Cooling unit no alarm present [3] = Cooling unit no fault present [4] = Cooling unit no leaked liquid
Displays the actual maximum output current of the power unit taking into account derating factors.
Display and BICO output for the second status word of faults and alarms.

descriere_scurta: Power unit alarm threshold model temperature
descriere: Temperature alarm threshold for the difference from the chip and heat sink temperature in the thermal model.
Threshold to detect a DC link undervoltage. If the DC link voltage falls below this threshold, the drive unit is tripped due to a DC link undervoltage condition.

The parameter is used to select a motor from a motor parameter list. When changing the code number (with the exception to the value 0), all of the motor parameters are pre-assigned from the internally available parameter lists.

Displays the rated power factor for induction motors. For IEC motors, the following applies (p0100 = 0): For p0308 = 0, the internally-calculated power factor is displayed. For p0308 > 0, this value is displayed. For NEMA motors, the following applies (p0100 = 1, 2): For p0309 = 0, the internally-calculated power factor is displayed. For p0309 > 0, this value is converted into the power factor and displayed.
Sets the cylinder dead volume on the A side.
Displays the identified voltage constant.
Displays the frequency limit of the signal output as maximum speed for the encoder emulation. The value is displayed independent of the operating mode set (p4400).
Sets the correction factor for the stall force at a 600 V DC link voltage.
Displays the identified reluctance torque constant.

Induction motors: Sets the rated motor magnetizing current. For p0320 = 0.000 the magnetizing current is internally calculated and displayed in r0331. Synchronous motors: Sets the rated motor short-circuit current.
Displays the rated motor torque.
Sets the torque constant of the synchronous motor.
Sets the motor limit current for synchronous motors (for a 600 V DC link voltage). Using this current, the maximum torque is achieved at the rated speed (voltage limit characteristic).
Sets the required damping for the controlled axis. With this value, for "Calculate controller data", the control loop (gain, integral time, rate time) is calculated.

descriere_scurta: Ratio between the total and motor moment of inertia
descriere: Sets the ratio between the total moment of inertia/mass (load + motor) and the intrinsic motor moment of inertia/mass (no load).

Induction motor: Displays the rated magnetizing current from p0320. For p0320 = 0, the internally calculated magnetizing current is displayed. Synchronous motor: Displays the rated short-circuit current from p0320.
Displays the identified stator resistance.
Sets the internal line diameter for the A and B sides.
Sets the proportional gain for the force controller.

The saturation characteristic (flux as mapping of current) is defined using 4 points. This parameter specifies the y coordinate (flux) for the 4th value pair of the characteristic. Induction motors (ASM) and separately-excited synchronous motors (SESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the magnetizing current onto the motor flux. The parameter sets the fourth motor flux as a [%] referred to the rated motor flux. Permanent-magnet synchronous motors (PESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the stator quadrature axis current onto the stator quadrature axis flux. The parameter sets the fourth stator quadrature axis flux as a [%] referred to the product of the unsaturated quadrature inductance (p0356) and the rated motor current.

The saturation characteristic (flux as mapping of current) is defined using 4 points. This parameter specifies the x coordinate for the 4th value pair of the characteristic. Induction motors (ASM) and separately-excited synchronous motors (SESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the magnetizing current onto the motor flux. The parameter sets the fourth magnetizing current as a [%] referred to the rated magnetizing current r0331 (ASM), which in turn is referred to the no-load excitation current (SESM). Permanent-magnet synchronous motors (PESM): The saturation characteristic describes the mapping of the stator quadrature axis current onto the stator quadrature axis flux. The parameter sets the fourth stator quadrature axis current as a [%] referred to the rated motor current (p0305).
Defines the ambient temperature of the motor for calculating the motor temperature model.
Selects the encoder from the list of encoder types supported.
Selects the gearbox type to pre-set the inversion and the gearbox factor. Measuring gear factor = motor or load revolutions / encoder revolutions.

descriere_scurta: Measuring gear position tracking tolerance window
descriere: Sets a tolerance window for position tracking. After the system is powered up, the difference between the saved position and the actual position is determined, and depending on this, the following is initiated: Difference within the tolerance window --> The position is reproduced as a result of the encoder actual value. Difference outside the tolerance window --> An appropriate message is output.

Sets the encoder revolutions for the gearbox factor of the encoder evaluation. The gearbox factor specifies the ratio between the encoder shaft and motor shaft (for motor encoders) or between the encoder shaft and the load.
Displays the extended properties supported by the Sensor Module.
Displays the effective filter time for a squarewave encoder. The filter time is set using p0438.
Copies the actual serial number of the encoder belonging to this Encoder Data Set (EDS) to p0441 ... p0445.
Displays the actual serial number part 5 of the appropriate encoder.
Sets the configuration for an SSI encoder.
Displays the detected encoder configuration. In this case, the encoder must automatically support the function (e.g. encoder with EnDat interface).
Settings for the basic encoder properties.
Serial number part 5 of the encoder for the commissioning.
Sets the extended configuration of the Sensor Module.
Sets the ramp-up time for the encoder. The encoder supplies stable track signals once this time has elapsed.
Displays the actual serial number part 3 of the appropriate encoder.
Displays the resolution of the absolute position for a linear absolute encoder.

descriere_scurta: Redundant coarse position value valid bits
descriere: Displays the valid bits of the redundant coarse position value.

descriere_scurta: Redundant coarse position value fine resolution bits
descriere: Displays the number of valid bits for the fine resolution of the redundant coarse position value.

descriere_scurta: Redundant coarse position value relevant bits
descriere: Displays the number of relevant bits for the redundant coarse position value.

descriere_scurta: Non safety-relevant measuring steps position value pos1
descriere: Displays the non safety-relevant measuring steps of POS1.
Displays the encoder configuration for the redundant coarse position value.

descriere_scurta: Gx_XIST1 coarse position safe most significant bit
descriere: Displays the bit number for the safe most significant bit (MSB) of the Gx_XIST1 coarse position.

descriere_scurta: Diagnostics encoder position actual value Gn_XIST1
descriere: Display and connector output for the encoder actual position value Gn_XIST1 according to PROFIdrive for diagnostics. In contrast to r0482, the value is updated in each DRIVE-CLiQ basic clock cycle and displayed with sign.
Displays the encoder status word Gn_ZSW according to PROFIdrive.
Displays the encoder actual position value Gn_XIST2 according to PROFIdrive.
Display and connector output for the encoder actual position value Gn_XIST1 according to PROFIdrive. Index: [0] = Encoder 1 [1] = Encoder 2 [2] = Encoder 3
Sets the configuration of the Sensor Module.

descriere_scurta: Measuring gear encoder raw value incremental
descriere: Displays the raw value of the incremental encoder actual value before the measuring gear.

descriere_scurta: Measuring gear encoder raw value absolute
descriere: Displays the raw value of the absolute encoder actual value before the measuring gear.
Displays the encoder control word Gn_STW according to PROFIdrive for diagnostics.

Sets the input terminal for direct measuring probe 1. The direct measuring probe can either be parameterized as a non-cyclic (value 1 ... 8) or a cyclic (value 11 ... 18) measuring probe. After it has been activated via binector input: p2509 = 0/1 signal, the non-cyclic measuring probe measures once and can be used with EPOS. After it has been activated via the p2509 = 1 signal, the cyclic measuring probe measures cyclically and cannot be used with EPOS. In order to process signals faster, the direct measuring probe bypasses the handshake technique via the encoder control word and encoder status word.

descriere_scurta: Motor model changeover speed encoderless operation
descriere: Sets the speed to change over the motor model to encoderless operation.
Display and BICO output for the status word of the current controller.
Selects the input terminal for connecting an equivalent zero mark (external encoder zero mark).
Displays the trace signal for encoder diagnostics (high component). The signal to be output is selected in p0496.
Displays the trace signal for encoder diagnostics (low component). The signal to be output is selected in p0496.

Sets the configuration for the motor model. Bit 0 = 1: Forces open-loop speed-controlled starting (ASM). Bit 1 = 1: Forces the system to pass through frequency zero, open-loop-controlled (ASM). Bit 2 = 1: Drive remains in full closed-loop control mode, even at zero frequency (ASM). Bit 3 = 1: Motor model evaluates the saturation characteristic (ASM).

Sets the reference quantities for the user-specific scaling. By indexing reference parameter p514[0..9], a total of 10 reference quantities are available: p514[0]reference quantity 01 p514[1]reference quantity 02 .. p514[8]reference quantity 09 p514[9]reference quantity 10 Up to 20 BiCos can be scaled to each of these 10 reference quantities. Assignment parameters p515[0..19] up to p524[0..19] have been introduced for this purpose.

Sets the bearing version. Corresponding to the bearing version entered, its code number (p0531) is automatically set. 0 = No selection 1 = Manual entry 101 = STANDARD 102 = PERFORMANCE 103 = HIGH PERFORMANCE 104 = ADVANCED LIFETIME

descriere_scurta: Inhibit list motor/closed-loop control parameter calculation
descriere: The inhibit list contains parameters that should be withdrawn from the automatic motor and closed-loop control parameter calculation (p0340, p0578).
Display and connector output for diagnostics word MT_DIAG.
Displays the velocity actual value measured using the BERO.

Displays the time between the last two BERO pulses. The measuring time is specified as 32-bit value with a resolution of 1/48 µs. If a new pulse is not received before the maximum measured time in p0583 expires, then r0587 is set to the maximum measuring time.

Displays the time since the last measuring pulse was detected. The delay time is specified as 32-bit value with a resolution of 1/48 µs. When a measuring pulse occurs (is received) the delay time is reset and is limited to the maximum measuring time in p0583.

Sets signal source 2 to evaluate the motor temperature via a BICO interconnection. Index: [0] = Motor temperature channel 1 [1] = Motor temperature channel 2 [2] = Motor temperature channel 3 [3] = Motor temperature channel 4
Sets the sensor to monitor the motor temperature. The sensor type used is set in p0601.

Sets the threshold for monitoring the motor temperature for motor temperature model 1/2 or KTY. Motor temperature model 1 (p0612.0 = 1): alarm threshold - Alarm A07012 is output after the alarm threshold is exceeded. Motor temperature model 2 (p0612.1 = 1) or KTY: fault threshold - Fault F07011 is output after the fault threshold is exceeded.
Defines the rated overtemperature of the squirrel cage rotor referred to ambient temperature.
Sets the system response when the motor temperature reaches the alarm threshold.
Adjustment of the mounting position referred to the A side of the cylinder.

descriere_scurta: Rs identification stator resistance after switch on again
descriere: Displays the stator resistance determined using the Rs identification after switching on again.

descriere_scurta: Motor excitation time for Rs_ident after powering up again
descriere: Sets the excitation time of the motor for the stator resistance identification after powering up again (restart).
Sets the rated motor power (rating plate).
The non-linear and cross-coupled quadrature axis flux functions are defined using 4 coefficients. The parameter weights the unsaturated component of the quadrature axis flux function.

descriere_scurta: Q flux direct axis current constant unsaturated
descriere: The non-linear and cross-coupled quadrature axis flux functions are defined using 4 coefficients. This parameter describes the interdependency of the unsaturated component of the direct axis current.
Sets the speed to change over between operation with and without an encoder. Above this speed, the drive system is automatically operated in encoderless mode.

Sets the configuration for the adaptation circuit of the motor model. Induction motor (ASM): Rs, Rr (only for operation with encoder), Lh and offset compensation. Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PEM): kT
Sets the service/maintenance intervals in hours for the appropriate motor. An appropriate fault is output when the operating hours set here are reached.

descriere_scurta: Motor magnetizing inductance transformed / Lh d axis saturated
descriere: Displays the magnetizing inductance of the motor. For separately-excited synchronous motors: Displays the saturated magnetizing inductance in the rotor direction (d-axis).
Displays the damping resistance of the separately-excited synchronous motor quadrature to the rotor direction (q axis).
Displays the ACX file saved in the appropriate directory in the non-volatile memory.

descriere_scurta: CU digital inputs terminal actual value
descriere: Displays the actual value at the digital inputs. This means that the actual input signal can be checked at terminal DI x or DI/DO x prior to switching from the simulation mode (p0795.x = 1) to terminal mode (p0795.x = 0).
Displays the inverted status of the digital inputs.
Displays the status of the digital inputs.

Displays the access authority at the digital outputs. Bit = 1: The control has access authority to the digital output via PROFIBUS or direct access. Bit = 0: The drive has access authority to the digital output or the digital input/output is not set as digital output or is not available.
Displays the status of digital outputs.

descriere_scurta: CU analog input input voltage/current actual
descriere: Displays the actual input voltage in V when set as voltage input. Displays the actual input current in mA when set as current input and with the load resistor switched in. Index: [0] = AI0 (X131.7, 8)

descriere_scurta: CU analog input characteristic value x1
descriere: Sets the scaling characteristic for the analog input of the CU310-2. The scaling characteristic for the analog input is defined using 2 points. This parameter specifies the x coordinate (input voltage in V or input current in mA) of the 1st value pair of the characteristic. Index: [0] = AI0 (X131.7, 8)
